## Add a company to the showcase

- [ ] The company runs PNLCS in production and bills real customers with it
- [ ] I work for this company or have its permission to list it
- [ ] `url` starts with `https://` and opens the company's public website
- [ ] `description` is in English, factual, and under 400 characters
- [ ] If I added a screenshot, it is in `assets/showcase/`, a `.webp` under 300 KB, and shows the public website only (no customer data)
